tasks.short: Draft mechanical details for completion or parts fabrication

steps.what: Draft the detail drawing or sketch, resolving geometry, dimensions and intended fabrication requirements
Check the detail drawing and submit it for drafting completion or the fabrication request

tasks.design: Retain the technician's detail interpretation and drawing in the mechanical design application in {OTHER}, with references in {DOCS}. The checked output is submitted for drafting completion or fabrication processing without assuming the technician can waive engineering approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: The central work is defining an unambiguous part from engineering intent and fabrication constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Native drafting tools already assist geometry; the digest does not demonstrate automatic mechanical detail interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving tolerances, missing dimensions and how the part will be made.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can recognise when an apparently complete sketch leaves a fabrication decision ambiguous.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in drafting responsibility or fabrication approval authority.

reach.task: Provide a sketch with explicit dimensions and unresolved questions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: creating and checking a mechanical detail requires design interpretation; no distinct repeated drawing-output saving is established here.

assumptions: Boundary ends at the technician's checked detail submission, excluding drafting-room completion, engineering approval and physical fabrication.

OTHER means the mechanical design application. The technician determines component identity, geometry, dimensions, tolerances, material, revision and unresolved fabrication constraints in s1 and s2. Capture and checking are fully counted.
No structured complete-design or fabrication-ready flag is assumed. Missing dimensions or unclear tolerances require manual engineering clarification before submission for that purpose.
Use existing native drawing tools first. No new template, integration or workflow is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether repeated view or table production is significant within this task
research_questions: Can a drawing sample isolate repeat rendering from substantive part definition and checking?

already_counted.description: Define, draw, check and submit the mechanical detail

approvals.approved_version: Exact detail drawing revision, dimensions, tolerances and intended submission purpose checked before handoff; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. A simple part sketch and an ambiguous fabrication detail both retain full definition and checking time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyse tests and adjust equipment to specifications

steps.what: Analyze test results against design specifications and objectives to determine the needed equipment change
Check the adjustment basis, modify or adjust equipment and verify its response against specifications

tasks.design: Keep analysis and physical adjustment with the technician under the existing engineering direction, using specifications in {DOCS}. No generated result or comparison automatically changes equipment settings or bypasses verification.
tasks.previous_blocker: A deviation's cause and the appropriate adjustment depend on actual equipment behaviour.
tasks.enabler_now: Test recording capabilities support evidence, but they do not establish an automatic corrective action for this task.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a measurement problem from a true equipment fault and checking unintended effects.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can inspect the equipment and revise the hypothesis after seeing its response.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in analysis, physical adjustment or engineering escalation responsibility.

reach.task: Explain the adjustment hypothesis and observed response

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and produces reports; this supports test evidence rather than autonomous equipment adjustment.

assumptions: Boundary is the technician's test interpretation, adjustment and response verification, excluding initial test execution and separate result documentation.

The technician checks test ID, equipment configuration, specification revision, result units, measurement quality and proposed adjustment during s1. Capture and interpretation remain fully counted; no free structured root-cause or safe-adjustment flag is assumed.

During s2 the technician directly observes the equipment response after adjustment. Response data are not available beforehand; unexpected results require stopping and manual engineering clarification.
Use existing native measurement and record tools. No new controller, model or workflow is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether numerical comparison is a separately measurable burden
research_questions: Can a timed analysis sample isolate repetitive numerical checks without removing causal reasoning or physical verification?

already_counted.description: Analyse, check, physically adjust and verify the equipment response

approvals.approved_version: Exact proposed adjustment, equipment configuration and specification basis checked before action within authorised limits; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. A routine adjustment and an unexplained test deviation both retain full interpretation, physical work and verification time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record test procedures, results and change recommendations

steps.what: Identify the performed test procedures and verify the numerical and graphical source data
Record procedure references, numerical results and selected graphs in the test record template
Check recorded results, write change recommendations and submit the final test record

tasks.design: Configure native test-record export from the test acquisition application in {OTHER} into a controlled template in {DOCS}. The technician selects and checks source records, then writes and verifies recommendations; the generator copies approved data and graphs without inventing interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test figures and procedure details may be copied manually between acquisition output, worksheets and documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native test reporting can place linked numerical and graphical data into repeat report sections.
tasks.still_hard: Ensuring the recorded procedure is what actually occurred and that recommendations follow from the evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The technician notices omitted deviations and unsupported recommendations.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated transcription; recommendation and record-checking responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Provide traceable test evidence and deviations
reach.learn: Source provenance and controlled test records

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and produces PDF or Word reports, supporting native test-result documentation.
Model knowledge: native export may remove transcription after input checking; the proposed task share and saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is recording existing procedures, results and recommendations, excluding conducting tests, equipment adjustment and the substantive analysis recorded in another task. Reused graphs are assigned once in a roll-up.

OTHER means the test acquisition application. In s1 the technician produces run ID, equipment configuration, actual procedure revision and deviations, selected channels and ranges, units, source file versions and graph choices. Capture, reconciling handwritten deviations and corrections remain fully counted.

Existing test operators produce the source measurements during test execution, outside this documentation boundary. The technician supplies recommendations in s3 using checked analysis findings; the generator never supplies a new recommendation.

Test native report export first. Missing channels, unclear procedure provenance or unit conflicts use manual record preparation and checking in s3. Added export and template maintenance is charged below.
unknowns: How actual procedure deviations are captured
research_questions: Can native export remove copying while preserving every deviation and the meaning of selected graphs?

already_counted.description: Validate source inputs, check the record and write recommendations

incremental.description: Resolve export exceptions and check template changes
Maintain test export maps and document templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact final record, run sources, procedure deviations, graphs and technician-authored recommendations; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R60 gives gross40, less focal upkeep7 gives net33. Range0-6 assumes most routine results already export and only a small share still needs repeated transcription; source checking and recommendations retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare mechanical or fluid-energy designs and specifications

steps.what: Prepare specifications, designs and sketches for mechanical or fluid-energy machines, components and systems
outputs: proposed energy equipment design and specification

tasks.design: Retain design interpretation and specification preparation in the mechanical design application in {OTHER}, with controlled references in {DOCS}. The technician provides a proposal under engineering direction, rather than a generated design accepted without engineering judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: The design must reconcile actual requirements, physical constraints and equipment interactions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing design tools assist representation, but no distinct repetitive output is established for this broad task.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing defensible assumptions and recognising interactions between mechanical and fluid systems.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can identify a proposal that meets isolated values but fails the overall engineering intent.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in design preparation or independent engineering approval.

reach.task: Explain design assumptions and unresolved system interactions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: mechanical and fluid-energy design preparation requires engineering interpretation; the digest does not establish a task-specific labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the technician's design and specification proposal, excluding final engineering approval and manufacture. If a detail sketch also falls under the specific drafting task, its labour must be assigned once.

OTHER means the mechanical design application. The technician establishes requirements, loads or flows, geometry, material assumptions, interfaces, units and source revisions during s1. Capture, checking and unresolved questions remain fully counted.
No structured acceptable-design flag is assumed. Uncertain requirements or system interactions are referred for manual engineering clarification.
Use native design and document tools first. No new model, template or integration is proposed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Actual design scope and the technician's authority
Whether repeat numerical or rendering work is separately measurable
research_questions: Can activity sampling isolate repeat calculations or document assembly without double counting the detail-drafting task?

already_counted.description: Interpret requirements and prepare the design and specification proposal

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. A component specification and an uncertain fluid-system design both retain full design interpretation time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native test-record generation where transcription exists while retaining mechanical design, causal analysis and physical adjustment.
reach: Provide quality staff with complete test provenance
Explain design and adjustment assumptions to engineers
role.ambitious_version: A technician who provides traceable test records efficiently and retains the engineering judgement and hands-on verification needed for reliable equipment changes.
